hero_subtitle: Making property search simple, transparent and convenient for everyone.
who_title: Your Journey to the Right Home Starts Here.
who_p1: Betenya (ቤተኛ) is a real estate platform designed to make finding properties easier for buyers, renters and property seekers across Ethiopia and beyond.
who_p2: We bring property listings and real estate professionals together in one modern, convenient platform — giving you access to verified listings with the tools to find exactly what you need.
values_subtitle: Everything we do is centered around creating a better, simpler and more trustworthy property experience.
values_transparency_desc: Clear property information with verified details helps you make confident, informed decisions.
values_convenience_desc: Search, compare and connect with agents — all from one modern platform.
values_trust_desc: Every listing is backed by professional agents with proven track records.
values_excellence_desc: We strive to provide the best property search experience in Ethiopia.
values_community_desc: Connecting buyers, renters, sellers and agents in one vibrant ecosystem.
values_growth_desc: Helping you make smart property investment decisions for a better future.
